resources.string: AI-generated content is for reference only. Do not take it as absolute truth or share private information.

User Agreement & Disclaimer

Welcome to this English speaking practice App.

I. Service Description
This App features an AI English tutor built on an open-source large language model. All AI inference runs entirely on your device, completely offline. This product is solely for English speaking practice.

II. AI Content Disclaimer
AI responses are generated automatically by the on-device model and do not reflect the views of the developer or any organization. Due to the limitations of on-device small models, AI may occasionally produce inaccurate or inappropriate content. Please use your judgment and do not take everything at face value.

III. Proper Use
You agree not to deliberately induce the AI to generate illegal, violent, pornographic, or rights-infringing content. All consequences arising from improper use are borne solely by the user. The developer assumes no responsibility.

IV. Privacy Protection
This App runs entirely offline. Your conversation data is not uploaded to any server, nor is it collected or shared. However, please do not input sensitive personal information such as bank passwords or ID numbers.

V. Minors
If you are a minor, please use this product under the supervision of a guardian.

By continuing to use this App, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to all the above terms.
